scenarios.expected: UpToDate only because all required authorities are evaluated; no recommendation

scenarios.expected: Machine-specific OEM wins after trust/applicability policy

scenarios.expected: Management authority visible but never fabricated as driver update

scenarios.name: Redirect to Untrusted Domain

scenarios.name: Offline
scenarios.expected: Inventory retained; update status unknown; no UpToDate

scenarios.name: Required Authority Not Evaluated

scenarios.name: Ignore Exact Version
scenarios.input: Ignore exact version from Provider A; Provider B same version/newer version visible
scenarios.expected: Provider-scoped suppression only; newer/different authority remains visible

scenarios.name: Rollback Available

scenarios.expected: Aggregate reboot unless provider/dependency boundary requires stop
